purpose: Independent RGB amodal native-MANO localization and learned 2D risk; then test as observations in the unchanged full native DiT/BA pipeline
train_data: existing v7 native targets and exact frozen WiLoR16x12 spatial features; no synthetic occlusion
control: same model, initialization, 600 updates, batches and objective; pooled repeats the mean token, removes spatial content only
batch: 3 distinct training people, 4 windows each, 7200 example exposures per arm
head: LayerNorm/linear128, convolution residual, two deterministic transposed-convolution upsamplers, 21x64x48 heatmaps, amodal soft coordinates
risk: RGB/coarse-2D conditional error>8 rotated-crop pixels; coordinates cannot consume coarse pose; image-band framing is not visibility
objective: heatmap KL sigma4 input pixels +5*coordinate L1 +0.2*inband BCE +0.2*(coarse/new 2D risk BCE)
selection: each100, dev inband head mean crop-pixel error +20*original accurate<=5px point harm>1px fraction
blend: 0.25*predicted-inband*coarse-bad-risk*(1-new-bad-risk); keep original observation; no GT input
evaluate: first freeze both heads' outputs on the six historical development clips and the complete clip2102 replay before this run scoring; report native2D, harm and paired recording CIs; then matched full BA and MANO parameter protection
inference_gates: unchanged5/10/30mm and +0.2px relative original WiLoR observation reference; do not relax to accept RGB changes
limitations: native GT is amodal model projection, not independently observed or visibility-labeled image joints
